data.label: NHANES Participant Governed Record
data.description: An NHANES participant record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier. Members: NHANES Participant; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov).

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: NHANES Participant
items.description: One NHANES 2017-2018 participant: the sequence number, the survey design, demographics, the blood pressure examination, laboratory results, smoking, medical conditions and physical functioning, joined on SEQN across the eight source files. Members: Respondent Sequence Number (SEQN); NHANES Survey Design; NHANES Demographics; NHANES Blood Pressure; NHANES Laboratory Results; NHANES Smoking; NHANES Medical Conditions; NHANES Physical Functioning.

items.label: Respondent Sequence Number (SEQN)
items.description: The NHANES respondent sequence number, the identifier every NHANES file carries for a participant (SEQN).

items.label: NHANES Blood Pressure
items.description: The blood pressure examination (BPX_J): the arm and cuff, the 60-second pulse as the FHIR heart rate by identifier and its regularity, the maximum inflation level, and up to three readings each as the FHIR blood pressure cluster. Members: Arm Selected (BPAARM); Coded Cuff Size (BPACSZ); heart-rate (FHIR); Pulse Regular or Irregular (BPXPULS); Maximum Inflation Level (BPXML1); Blood Pressure Reading 1; Blood Pressure Reading 2; Blood Pressure Reading 3.

items.label: Arm Selected (BPAARM)
items.description: The arm the blood pressure was measured on (BPAARM).

items.label: Coded Cuff Size (BPACSZ)
items.description: The blood pressure cuff size used (BPACSZ).

items.label: Pulse Regular or Irregular (BPXPULS)
items.description: Whether the pulse was regular or irregular (BPXPULS).

items.label: Maximum Inflation Level (BPXML1)
items.description: The maximum inflation level used, in mm Hg (BPXML1).

items.label: Heart Rate
items.description: Heart Rate (LOINC 8867-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Blood Pressure Reading 1
items.description: The first of the seated blood pressure readings (BPXSY1, BPXDI1): the FHIR blood pressure cluster by identifier. Members: blood-pressure (FHIR).

items.label: Blood Pressure
items.description: A blood pressure reading: systolic and diastolic, body site, status and time.

items.label: Observation Status
items.description: The status of the observation result. FHIR Observation.status; ObservationStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Diastolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8462-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Systolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8480-6), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Observation Date Time
items.description: The clinically relevant time of the observation. FHIR Observation.effectiveDateTime.

items.label: Body Site (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The body site the observation was made on. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Observation.bodySite.

items.label: Code System: SNOMED CT
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: SNOMED CT (http://snomed.info/sct). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Body Site Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the body site the observation was made on. FHIR Observation.bodySite, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code (FHIR Coding.display).

items.label: Blood Pressure Reading 2
items.description: The second of the seated blood pressure readings (BPXSY2, BPXDI2): the FHIR blood pressure cluster by identifier. Members: blood-pressure (FHIR).

items.label: Blood Pressure Reading 3
items.description: The third of the seated blood pressure readings (BPXSY3, BPXDI3): the FHIR blood pressure cluster by identifier. Members: blood-pressure (FHIR).

items.label: NHANES Demographics
items.description: The participant's demographics: the Default administrative gender and the NHANES gender code, the NIH CDE age with age in months for infants, race/ethnicity as the NIH CDE and as NHANES codes it, country of birth, citizenship, education and marital status as the NIH CDE and as NHANES codes them, pregnancy status, household size, the agency's income range and the income-to-poverty ratio. Members: administrative-gender (Default); Gender (RIAGENDR); Age (NIH CDE); Age in Months at Screening (RIDAGEMN); Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification (NIH CDE); Race/Hispanic Origin with NH Asian (RIDRETH3); Country of Birth (DMDBORN4); Citizenship Status (DMDCITZN); Current Educational Attainment (NIH CDE); Education Level - Adults 20+ (DMDEDUC2); Marital Status (NIH CDE); Marital Status (DMDMARTL); Are you pregnant now? (NIH CDE); Pregnancy Status at Exam (RIDEXPRG); Veteran Status; Total Number of People in the Household (DMDHHSIZ); Annual Household Income (INDHHIN2); Ratio of Family Income to Poverty (INDFMPIR).

items.label: Annual Household Income (INDHHIN2)
items.description: Annual household income in the agency's ranges (INDHHIN2). Not harmonized: the NHANES, BRFSS and NIH CDE income ranges do not nest, so each study keeps its own.

items.label: Citizenship Status (DMDCITZN)
items.description: Citizenship status (DMDCITZN).

enumerations: Not a citizen of the US

items.label: Country of Birth (DMDBORN4)
items.description: Whether the participant was born in the 50 US states or Washington, DC, or elsewhere (DMDBORN4).
items.value: Born in 50 US states or Washington, DC

enumerations: Born in 50 US states or Washington, DC

items.label: Education Level - Adults 20+ (DMDEDUC2)
items.description: The highest grade or level of school completed, adults 20 and over (DMDEDUC2). Kept beside the NIH CDE Current Educational Attainment it is mapped to.

items.label: Gender (RIAGENDR)
items.description: The participant's gender as NHANES codes it (RIAGENDR). Kept beside the Default administrative gender it is mapped to.

items.label: Marital Status (DMDMARTL)
items.description: Marital status as NHANES codes it (DMDMARTL). Kept beside the NIH CDE Marital Status it is mapped to.

items.label: Pregnancy Status at Exam (RIDEXPRG)
items.description: Pregnancy status at the examination, females 20-44 (RIDEXPRG). Kept beside the NIH CDE pregnancy question it is mapped to.

enumerations: Yes, positive lab pregnancy test or self-reported pregnant at exam
Cannot ascertain if pregnant at exam

items.label: Race/Hispanic Origin with NH Asian (RIDRETH3)
items.description: Race and Hispanic origin as NHANES codes it (RIDRETH3). Kept beside the NIH CDE Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification it is mapped to; the mapping is in the generator and Other Race including multi-racial has no CDE value.

items.label: Veteran Status
items.description: Whether the person has ever served on active duty in the United States Armed Forces (NHANES DMQMILIZ; BRFSS VETERAN3).

items.label: Are you pregnant now?
items.description: A textual description of the person's current pregnancy status. Also known as: Current Pregnancy Indicator. NIH CDE Repository, steward Project 5, tinyId LiUWCWluP, NIH endorsed.

items.label: Current Educational Attainment
items.description: A textual description of the grade or highest level of education attained by a human being. Question text: What is the highest grade or level of school you have completed or the highest degree you have received? NIH CDE Repository, steward Project 5, tinyId Co2d1RyYS3, NIH endorsed.

enumerations: Bachelors Degree (Example: BA, AB, BS, BBA)
Masters Degree (Example:  MA, MS, MEng, MEd, MBA)

items.label: Marital Status
items.description: A demographic parameter indicating a person's current conjugal status. Question text: What is your current marital status? NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId C6SezX_mKG, NIH endorsed.
items.value: Living as married or living with a romantic partner

enumerations: Living as married or living with a romantic partner
Married or partnered, but not living together
Single, never been married-not living with romantic partner

items.label: Race/Ethnicity Self-Identification
items.description: A textual description of a person's race. C17049 |The ethnicity of a person. C16564 | An individual's perspective or subjective interpretation of an event or information. C74528 Question text: Please select the racial/ethnic category or categories with which you most closely identify. Select all that apply. NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId LakF0YkywC, NIH endorsed.

enumerations: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

items.label: Administrative Gender
items.description: The gender a person is recorded as for administrative purposes. Not clinical or biological sex; see Sex (Recorded).

items.label: Age in Months at Screening (RIDAGEMN)
items.description: Age in months at screening, reported for participants aged 0 to 24 months (RIDAGEMN).

items.label: Total Number of People in the Household (DMDHHSIZ)
items.description: Total number of people in the household (DMDHHSIZ; 7 means 7 or more).

items.label: Age
items.description: The number of years (if more than 24 months old) or months (if 24 months or younger) that the person has been alive. Question text: What is the person's age (in years if more than 24 months old or months if 24 months or younger)? NIH CDE Repository, steward NIMHD, tinyId PDjBiGXjO, NIH endorsed.

items.label: Ratio of Family Income to Poverty (INDFMPIR)
items.description: The ratio of family income to the poverty guideline (INDFMPIR; 5 means 5 or more).

items.label: NHANES Medical Conditions
items.description: The medical conditions questionnaire (MCQ_J): the shared chronic condition indicators on a self-report basis, whether asthma persists, and whether a doctor said the participant was overweight. Members: Chronic Condition Indicators; Still Have Asthma (MCQ035); Doctor Ever Said You Were Overweight (MCQ080).

items.label: Doctor Ever Said You Were Overweight (MCQ080)
items.description: Whether a doctor or health professional ever said the participant was overweight (MCQ080).

items.label: Still Have Asthma (MCQ035)
items.description: Whether the participant still has asthma (MCQ035).

items.label: Chronic Condition Indicators
items.description: The chronic conditions a study records for a person, one indicator per condition, with the basis on which the study established them. NHANES and BRFSS carry the ones their questionnaires ask; CMS carries the eleven its chronic conditions flags define; every study that carries an indicator carries the same component. Members: Condition Indicator Basis; Condition: Asthma; Condition: Arthritis; Condition: Congestive Heart Failure; Condition: Coronary Heart Disease; Condition: Angina; Condition: Heart Attack; Condition: Stroke; Condition: Emphysema; Condition: Chronic Bronchitis; Condition: COPD; Condition: Liver Condition; Condition: Thyroid Problem; Condition: Cancer; Condition: Skin Cancer; Condition: Depression; Condition: Kidney Disease; Condition: Diabetes; Condition: Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder; Condition: Osteoporosis; Condition: High Blood Pressure; Condition: High Cholesterol.

items.label: Condition: Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder
items.description: Whether the person has alzheimer's disease or related disorder (Alzheimer's Disease or Related Disorder, SNOMED CT 26929004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by CMS SP_ALZHDMTA.

items.label: Condition: Angina
items.description: Whether the person has angina (Angina, SNOMED CT 194828000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160D.

items.label: Condition: Arthritis
items.description: Whether the person has arthritis (Arthritis, SNOMED CT 3723001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160A, BRFSS HAVARTH4, CMS SP_RA_OA.

items.label: Condition: Asthma
items.description: Whether the person has asthma (Asthma, SNOMED CT 195967001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ010, BRFSS ASTHMA3.

items.label: Condition: Cancer
items.description: Whether the person has cancer (Cancer, SNOMED CT 363346000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ220, BRFSS CHCOCNC1, CMS SP_CNCR.

items.label: Condition: Chronic Bronchitis
items.description: Whether the person has chronic bronchitis (Chronic Bronchitis, SNOMED CT 63480004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160K.

items.label: Condition: Congestive Heart Failure
items.description: Whether the person has congestive heart failure (Congestive Heart Failure, SNOMED CT 42343007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160B, CMS SP_CHF.

items.label: Condition: COPD
items.description: Whether the person has copd (COPD, SNOMED CT 13645005), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160O, BRFSS CHCCOPD3, CMS SP_COPD.

items.label: Condition: Coronary Heart Disease
items.description: Whether the person has coronary heart disease (Coronary Heart Disease, SNOMED CT 53741008), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160C, BRFSS CVDCRHD4, CMS SP_ISCHMCHT.

items.label: Condition: Depression
items.description: Whether the person has depression (Depression, SNOMED CT 35489007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS ADDEPEV3, CMS SP_DEPRESSN.

items.label: Condition: Diabetes
items.description: Whether the person has diabetes (Diabetes, SNOMED CT 73211009), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS DIABETE4, CMS SP_DIABETES.

items.label: Condition: Emphysema
items.description: Whether the person has emphysema (Emphysema, SNOMED CT 87433001), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160G.

items.label: Condition: Heart Attack
items.description: Whether the person has heart attack (Heart Attack, SNOMED CT 22298006), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160E, BRFSS CVDINFR4.

items.label: Condition: High Blood Pressure
items.description: Whether the person has high blood pressure (High Blood Pressure, SNOMED CT 38341003), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS BPHIGH6.

items.label: Condition: High Cholesterol
items.description: Whether the person has high cholesterol (High Cholesterol, SNOMED CT 13644009), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS TOLDHI3.

items.label: Condition Indicator Basis
items.description: How a study established its chronic condition indicators: the person's report of what a health professional told them (NHANES, BRFSS) or the presence of qualifying diagnosis codes in claims (CMS). Stated once per record so the three studies compare on equal terms.

items.label: Condition: Kidney Disease
items.description: Whether the person has kidney disease (Kidney Disease, SNOMED CT 709044004), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS CHCKDNY2, CMS SP_CHRNKIDN.

items.label: Condition: Liver Condition
items.description: Whether the person has liver condition (Liver Condition, SNOMED CT 235856003), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160L.

items.label: Condition: Osteoporosis
items.description: Whether the person has osteoporosis (Osteoporosis, SNOMED CT 64859006), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by CMS SP_OSTEOPRS.

items.label: Condition: Skin Cancer
items.description: Whether the person has skin cancer (Skin Cancer, SNOMED CT 372130007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by BRFSS CHCSCNC1.

items.label: Condition: Stroke
items.description: Whether the person has stroke (Stroke, SNOMED CT 230690007), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160F, BRFSS CVDSTRK3, CMS SP_STRKETIA.

items.label: Condition: Thyroid Problem
items.description: Whether the person has thyroid problem (Thyroid Problem, SNOMED CT 14304000), on the basis the record states in its Condition Indicator Basis: told by a health professional, or found in claims. Carried by NHANES MCQ160M.

items.label: NHANES Smoking
items.description: Cigarette use (SMQ_J): the two questions the smoking status derives from, the status itself as the shared component, the age started, the recent daily count and e-cigarette use. Members: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes in Life (SMQ020); Do You Now Smoke Cigarettes (SMQ040); Smoking Status; Age Started Smoking Cigarettes Regularly (SMD030); Average Cigarettes per Day, Past 30 Days (SMD650); Ever Used an E-cigarette (SMQ900).

items.label: Do You Now Smoke Cigarettes (SMQ040)
items.description: Whether the participant now smokes cigarettes every day, some days or not at all (SMQ040).

items.label: Ever Used an E-cigarette (SMQ900)
items.description: Whether the participant has ever used an e-cigarette (SMQ900).

items.label: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes in Life (SMQ020)
items.description: Whether the participant has smoked at least 100 cigarettes in their life (SMQ020).

items.label: Smoking Status
items.description: Tobacco smoking status (LOINC 72166-2) as the survey establishes it: NHANES from SMQ020 and SMQ040, BRFSS from SMOKE100 and SMOKDAY2 (the agency's _SMOKER3 is kept beside it). The LOINC answer list LL2201-3.

items.label: Average Cigarettes per Day, Past 30 Days (SMD650)

items.description: The survey design fields a weighted estimate needs: the release cycle, interview and examination status, the interview and MEC weights, the pseudo-PSU and pseudo-stratum. items.label: Data Release Cycle (SDDSRVYR)
items.description: The NHANES data release cycle (SDDSRVYR).

items.label: Interview/Examination Status (RIDSTATR)
items.description: Whether the participant was interviewed only, or interviewed and examined at the mobile examination center (RIDSTATR).

items.label: Masked Variance Pseudo-PSU (SDMVPSU)
items.description: The masked variance pseudo primary sampling unit (SDMVPSU).

items.label: Masked Variance Pseudo-Stratum (SDMVSTRA)
items.description: The masked variance pseudo stratum (SDMVSTRA).

items.label: Full Sample 2 Year Interview Weight (WTINT2YR)
items.description: The full-sample two-year interview weight (WTINT2YR), for weighted estimates of the interviewed sample.

items.label: Full Sample 2 Year MEC Exam Weight (WTMEC2YR)
items.description: The full-sample two-year MEC examination weight (WTMEC2YR); zero for participants not examined.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.
